source_closure.summary: Add a pure fail-closed composite inventory verifier that permits distinct component source commits only when exact identities and Runtime/Engine Pack/PX4/Gazebo compatibility agree, then require its exact verified receipt before P5 can create a zero-work RED execution ledger.

properties: Desktop, Runtime Base, Engine Pack, PX4, and Gazebo may use distinct source commits; source equality is not a generic compatibility rule.
Each declared component identity must exactly match its trusted observed version, source commit when applicable, artifact hash, and manifest hash.
Runtime and Engine Pack must agree on runtime product/version, Python version, dependency lock, PX4 commit, and Gazebo version.
Desktop participation additionally binds the supported Runtime product and Engine API version.
Prompt, response schema, tool, model, machine, concurrency, repository, evaluator, coordinator, and evidence-head identities are exact bindings.
Unknown fields, missing source pins, manifest/artifact byte drift, component-presence drift, and any compatibility mismatch fail closed.
A verified receipt always carries execution_authorized=false and cannot start work by itself.
P5 authorization binds both the verified receipt content and its SHA-256; denied, tampered, wrong-inventory, or incomplete-component receipts are rejected before ledger creation.

preserved_failures.root_cause: The SHA fixture generator repeated hexadecimal numbers such as 10 and 11 sixty-four times, producing 128-byte strings; strict SHA validation correctly rejected every fixture.
preserved_failures.fix: Encode fixture indices as one zero-padded 64-character lowercase hexadecimal value without weakening SHA validation.
